overall_goal: Add dressing and seasonings to the salad and toss to combine

goals.description: Add olive oil to the salad
goals.rationale: The person prepares the salad bowl and repeatedly measures and pours olive oil into the salad.

goals.description: Add balsamic glaze and seasonings to the salad
goals.rationale: The person measures and adds balsamic glaze, followed by grinding salt and pepper into the salad bowl.
The person uses two spoons to mix and toss the salad ingredients with the dressing.
